name: io.github.maglionejm/bokken
description: Design Thinking as an executable, event-sourced, governed process: run autonomous discovery loops against your repo/metrics/interviews, gate them, and get an evidence-traced dossier, reports, and build-ready OpenSpec handoff. 14 tools, journaled client identity, confined input paths.

runtime_arguments.description: start the MCP server on stdio

environment_variables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: provider key for real runs (bokken demo needs none)

environment_variables.name: BOKKEN_INPUT_ROOTS
environment_variables.description: colon-separated roots client-supplied input paths are confined to
